name: Primrose Education Scholarship
description: The Primrose Schools of Lakeway and Bee Cave believe education should be positive, engaging, and joyful. This scholarship will be awarded to a student who embodies these characteristics.

name: Hawkinds Foundation Mens Soccer Scholarship
description:
Bernalee Hawkins was a teacher for over 30 years, and her greatest joy was helping others continue their education. In fact, she enjoyed Lake Travis Education Foundation involvement in her retirement.

This scholarship continues her legacy of ongoing learning by giving preference to members of the Lake Travis High School men’s soccer team who intend to continue their education after graduation, whether at a college or university, or at a trade or vocational school.

Preference will be given to current well-rounded 2 year members of the LTHS Men’s Soccer team who have achieved strong academic results and exhibited leadership qualities while also devoting significant time and effort to their sport.
